actions.purpose: 练肚子，让整个身体像一块板一样硬

zh: 腰死死贴住地，肩和腿一起离地
手臂贴着耳朵往远伸，两腿并拢伸直。
肚子绷住，像有人要往上放一本书，别憋气。

cautions: 腰贴不住或腰疼，就把腿抬高点，或者弯着膝盖做
脖子酸就收一点下巴，别往前探头
actions.repairReason: V4 全量重渲（新建模，main d6fb47c；开哥 2026-11-14 定版）
actions.purposeEn: Builds your abs so your whole body stays stiff like one board.
cuesEn: Glue your lower back down, lift shoulders and legs
Reach your arms long by your ears, legs straight and together.
Brace like someone's about to set a book on your belly, and keep breathing.

commonErrors.zh: 腰拱起来，手能从腰底下塞进去
commonErrors.en: Lower back arching up so a hand could slide under it.
Holding your breath to tough it out.

cautionsEn: If your lower back lifts or hurts, raise your legs higher or bend your knees.
If your neck gets sore, tuck your chin a little and don't poke your head forward.

actions.nameZh: 平行杆团身 L 撑
actions.muscleGroupsZh: 腹直肌（含深层腹横肌）、髋屈肌
actions.purpose: 练肚子和抬腿的劲，两手把自己撑离地面

zh: 手臂撑直，膝盖往胸口收
肩膀往下沉，离耳朵远点，别耸肩。
撑稳了再试着一条腿往前伸直，两条腿轮流。

cautions: 撑起来手腕吃全身重量，先转转手腕；刺疼就下来
撑不起腿就脚尖点地，先只把身体撑住
actions.repairReason: V4 全量重渲（新建模，main d6fb47c；开哥 2026-11-14 定版）
actions.purposeEn: Builds your abs and the strength to lift your legs while you hold yourself up.
cuesEn: Lock your arms, pull your knees to your chest
Push your shoulders down away from your ears. No shrugging.
Once it's steady, try kicking one leg out straight, then the other.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging until your neck disappears.
Knees slowly dropping.

cautionsEn: Your wrists hold all your weight here. Roll them out first, and come down if they get sharp pain.
Can't lift your legs yet? Keep your toes down and just hold yourself up.

Lower slowly. No swinging.
